response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS match_count, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS average_match_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.average_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - b.average_match_count) AS average_excess_match_count FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.match_count > b.average_match_count
